page_title: LAZ 3-1 FRO | Lazio v Frosinone 29/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+4' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Gustav Isaksen (Lazio), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
90+3' Lazio are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone) replacing Marco Brescianini.
89' Here comes a substitution. Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) is brought on as a substitute for Matias Soule.
86' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Mattia Zaccagni and he is replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
86' Substitution. Nicolo Rovella leaves the pitch and is replaced by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio).
84' 3 - 1 GOAL - 3:1! The corner comes over and Taty Castellanos flicks on with his head to Patric (Lazio), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
84' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:2.
80' A goal, which was scored by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio), was disallowed due to offside.
79' The substitution has been made. Giorgi Kvernadze (Frosinone) has replaced Luca Garritano.
78' The referee gives a yellow card to Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone).
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) was quite harsh and Ermano Feliciani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) will take the corner.
75' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Kaio Jorge is replaced by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone).
75' A substitution has been made. Abdou Harroui is replaced by Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone).
74' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

72' 2 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Taty Castellanos picks out an unmarked Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.

70' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) makes it 2:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Gustav Isaksen and planted his close-range header into the top right corner. Stefano Turati was helpless.
66' Today's match ends for Daichi Kamada who will be replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
63' Frosinone failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Kaio Jorge (Frosinone).
63' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
58' 0 - 1 Goal! Matias Soule (Frosinone) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Ivan Provedel into the bottom right corner.
58' Matias Soule (Frosinone) is going to take the penalty!
58' Maurizio Sarri is stunned as referee Ermano Feliciani shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
56' The Frosinone players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
56' Patric (Lazio) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
55' There's a break in play and referee Ermano Feliciani must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Frosinone using VAR. This could be interesting!
55' That looked a certain handball by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
54' Luca Pellegrini is substituted due to injury. Maurizio Sarri gives a chance to Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).
53' The game is interrupted now, Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Great teamplay by Lazio as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
49' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle. Luca Garritano (Frosinone) commits a foul after dangerous play.
49' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
48' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Maurizio Sarri probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Felipe Anderson. He is replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
45+2' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) releases Mattia Zaccagni, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
45+1' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Fine play by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the right post.
40' Frosinone concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.

38' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
38' Corner kick. Frosinone will have an opportunity.

37' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Frosinone will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
33' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
31' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Ermano Feliciani stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
30' Lazio work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
30' Adam Marusic (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
27' Ermano Feliciani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio).
25' Lazio enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
24' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) is able to continue to play.
22' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
21' The game is interrupted. Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) suffers a horrific injury!
21' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
20' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
20' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.
19' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
19' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
15' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) produces a poor cross from the free kick which is easily turned away.
15' Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.

14' Felipe Anderson almost found himself in a promising position after Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
12' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
11' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
11' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
9' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
7' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
6' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lazio.
3' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
3' Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Frosinone will take the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani will supervise the game today.
